1) 先确认是否是计划内发布：查看变更记录与 shell 历史；2) 非计划则执: 1) First confirm whether this was a planned release by checking change records and shell history; 2) If unplanned, run journalctl -u httpd --since '-30min' and tail -200 error_log to determine whether it was a segfault, an OOM, or a configuration error; 3) For an OOM kill, confirm with dmesg -T | grep -i 'killed process' and lower MaxRequestWorkers based on real per-worker memory; 4) For repeated crashes, keep core dumps (CoreDumpDirectory) and bisect by disabling third-party modules one at a time.
1) 在 access_log 的 LogFormat 里确认已带 %D（微秒耗: 1) Confirm the access_log LogFormat includes %D (microsecond duration), then run awk '{print $NF, $7}' access_log | sort -rn | head -20 to find the slowest URLs; 2) If the slow URLs are dynamic requests, move on to the backend (PHP-FPM slowlog, application logs, database slow queries); 3) If static assets are slow, check disk IO and whether sendfile or caching was accidentally disabled; 4) While investigating, apply mod_ratelimit or degrade that URL so workers are not held indefinitely.
1) 执行 curl -s 'http://127.0.0.1/server-s: 1) Run curl -s 'http://127.0.0.1/server-status?auto' and compare BusyWorkers against the open_slot headroom in the Scoreboard; 2) Use tail -n 10000 access_log | awk to rank URLs by count and latency, and decide whether this is genuine traffic growth or one slow endpoint holding workers; 3) For traffic growth, scale out instances or raise MaxRequestWorkers (recalculating ServerLimit against memory); 4) For a slow endpoint, fix the backend first and apply mod_reqtimeout or rate limiting to that URL so a single endpoint cannot drain the whole process pool.

1) Run curl -s 'http://127.0.0.1/server-status?auto' and read the Scoreboard to see which state workers are stuck in (W = sending reply, meaning a slow backend; R = reading request, meaning slow clients); 2) If they are stuck in W, first check whether the backend (PHP-FPM, database, upstream API) has slowed down, and use tail -f access_log to find the slow URLs from the response-time column; 3) As a stopgap, raise MaxRequestWorkers and ServerLimit and reload gracefully, but re-check memory first (per-worker memory x concurrency must not exceed physical memory); 4) If slow clients are holding workers, enable mod_reqtimeout and lower KeepAliveTimeout.
1) 登录主机执行 systemctl status httpd（或 apach: 1) Log in to the host and run systemctl status httpd (or apache2) to confirm whether the master process is alive; 2) If the process is alive, run curl -s 'http://127.0.0.1/server-status?auto' to verify by hand whether the status page is blocked by a Require directive or a firewall; 3) If the process is gone, run httpd -t to validate the configuration before starting it, and check the tail of error_log for the cause (port already in use, expired certificate, module load failure are common); 4) Confirm the upstream load balancer has removed this node so traffic stops being sent to it.
Apache 已连续 3 分钟没有任何空闲 worker，新连接只能在内核 ac: Apache has had no idle worker for 3 minutes. New connections can only queue in the kernel accept queue, which clients experience as connection timeouts or slow responses.
Apache 平均请求处理耗时过长: Apache average request duration too long
Apache 的 ServerUptime 小于 5 分钟，说明进程刚重启过；若: Apache's ServerUptime is under 5 minutes, so the process restarted recently. If this was not planned, it usually means a crash, an OOM kill, or a failed configuration reload.
最近 5 分钟 Apache 平均每个请求的处理耗时超过 1 秒（由 mod_s: Over the last 5 minutes Apache's average per-request processing time exceeded 1 second (derived from mod_status Total Duration / Total Accesses). Users can already feel the slowdown.
繁忙 worker 已占总 worker 槽位（Scoreboard 全部槽位之: Busy workers have exceeded 85% of all worker slots (the sum of every Scoreboard state) for 5 minutes. Any further growth will exhaust the connection handling capacity.
采集端已连续 1 分钟拉不到 Apache 的 mod_status，httpd: The collector has been unable to fetch Apache mod_status for 1 minute. The httpd process may have exited or the status page may be unreachable, and HTTP traffic through this instance may already be down.
